A Cordless Drill Is A Powerful Tool For Any Homeowner
A cordless drill can save you time and effort when you need to make a hole in your wall, ceiling or floor.
Cordless drills are available in a range of sizes and power levels to suit all your needs. A larger cordless drill is recommended if you will be drilling holes through several types of materials, such as drywall, steel, and concrete. A smaller cordless drill is suitable for drilling holes in thinner materials, such as wood and sheetrock.
To use a cordless drill, turn it on and place it firmly on the material you are drilling. Hold the drill firmly with one hand while you press down on the trigger. Make sure your hands are away from the drill bit at all times. Once you have drilled the hole, carefully remove the drill from the material.
Tips for Safely Using a Cordless Drill
1. Always wear safety glasses when using a cordless drill, and secure the power cord away from your work area.

· Always hold the drill with both hands while using it.
· Keep the drill away from your body while it is running.
· Always unplug the drill before changing the batteries or charging.
· When changing the drill bit, set it down away from your body and your legs.
· When charging the drill, do not leave it unattended.
· Store your cordless drill in a dry place and keep it away from heat sources.
· Never use a cordless drill on wet or oily surfaces.
